title: Skyfall Survival
description: A small & friendly survival server, we support both Java and Bedrock players.
body:
# Skyfall Survival
A small but friendly survival server with a laid-back community where everyone is welcome. Our server supports both Java and Bedrock Edition players. Whether you want to build, survive, or just meet people and chat, there is a place for you here. We would be happy to have you as part of our community. <3

## Why Skyfall?
Skyfall Survival is a small server, dedicated to curating a community for everyone.
We ensure the server is as vanilla as possible.
Skyfall Survival has a select amount of plugins on the server, of which are to prevent griefing, improving server stability, or [quality of life](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quality_of_life) additions for our players.

We try to be as inclusive as possible for our community, and future members of our community. <3

## How to join
We have a soft-whitelist process, so you will need to join our Discord and message our bot a code, and you will get automatically whitelisted. 
1. Join the server, and it will give you a code.
2. DM our bot `Skyfall#9247` that code, and you will be whitelisted. (Bot ID: `1446664681035923497`)
3. You should now be able to join the server.

## Our Rules
We have barely any rules, so we kindly ask that you respect all of them if you would like to play on the server.
1. Be respectful
2. No [bigotry](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/bigotry)
3. Use common sense
4. No griefing

### Optional Mods
[Simple Voice Chat](<https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat>)\
[Female Gender Mod](<https://modrinth.com/mod/female-gender>)\
Optional mods are not available for Bedrock!
